Apple is preparing to unveil its latest flagship iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra, continuing the company's long-established launch pattern. Below are our predicted dates for the iPhone 18 Pro announcement event and its market availability, along with relevant details about this product line.

The iPhone 18 Pro launch event will take place in September, but there is one notable detail to keep in mind.

The iPhone is Apple's most important product, accounting for the lion's share of its revenue. One of the ways Apple keeps the iPhone business healthy is by rolling out new flagship models every year.

For years, these new iPhone models have been announced in September — and all signs point to the same timeline this year.

Here are the dates of the three most recent iPhone launches:

  • 2025: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • 2024: September 9 (Monday)
  • 2023: September 12 (Tuesday)

As you can see, Apple's iPhone announcement schedule is remarkably consistent, with the main flagship models typically unveiled around the second week of September.

One variable this year is that Labor Day falls unusually late, landing on September 7. Apple is unlikely to ask the press to travel on a U.S. federal holiday, which rules out September 8 as a possible date.

This means the earliest the event could take place is September 9 (Wednesday).

September 9 lines up with the dates from the past two years and also matches Apple's approach in 2022, when the new iPhone was announced two days after Labor Day.

If September 9 doesn't pan out, the latest expected announcement date would fall at the beginning of the following week.

Either way, early to mid-September is when the iPhone 18 Pro will officially make its debut.

However, one major change expected this year is that the standard iPhone 18 won't hit the market until early 2027. Rumor has it that Apple's flagship lineup this autumn will consist of just three models:

iPhone 18 Pro predicted release date

Although the exact date of Apple's iPhone launch event may shift slightly due to Labor Day, the shipping timeline after the event is quite consistent: the new devices typically go on sale the Friday following the announcement.

So if the iPhone 18 Pro is unveiled on September 9 (Wednesday), pre-orders would open on September 11 (or September 12, a Saturday, to avoid the September 11 anniversary), with the new devices officially reaching users on September 18 (Friday).

Looking back at Apple's recent iPhone launch history confirms this pattern.

2025: iPhone 17

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 12 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 19 (Friday)

2024: iPhone 16

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Monday)
  • Pre-order date: September 13 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 20 (Friday)

2023: iPhone 15

  • Announcement date: September 12 (Tuesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 15 (Friday)
  • Release date: September 22 (Friday)

Unless Apple breaks from its usual pattern this year, September 18 is the day users will be able to get their hands on the iPhone 18 Pro.

iPhone 18 Pro release date: summary

In summary, based on Apple's historical patterns, here are our predictions for the iPhone 18 lineup's announcement and release dates.

2026: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Ultra

  • Announcement date: September 9 (Wednesday)
  • Pre-order date: September 11 (Friday) or September 12 (Saturday)
  • Release date: September 18 (Friday)

The iPhone Ultra's release timing may be slightly later than the iPhone 18 Pro, but nothing has been confirmed yet.

Which new iPhone 18 model are you planning to buy? Let us know in the comments.
